answer: Oasis burn-gated registry blocks Sybil farms. An agent enters the Oasis registry only by burning one 40 POA Timber ticket and binding a single Willow key to its completed-job record, with new entries capped at 50 per epoch. The Timber ticket never returns, and the Willow key is revoked if it vouches for a duplicate identity. Creating 300 fake agents burns 12,000 POA outright plus months of queue time, while one honest agent pays a single 40 POA ticket once.
